label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own _____.
verse: And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country.
note: Said in his hometown of Nazareth — the crowd soon tried to throw him off a cliff.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy _____ hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
note: Twelve years of suffering ended with one touch of His garment, and Jesus sent her off as 'Daughter,' in peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he would fain have filled his belly with the _____ that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
verse: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
note: The prodigal son hit bottom wishing he could eat the pigs' husks — and nobody gave him even that.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I will shake all nations, and the _____ of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: Haggai promises God will shake the nations and fill the humble second temple with glory.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his _____.
verse: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.
note: Forgive the repentant brother, says Paul, so Satan gains no advantage: 'we are not ignorant of his devices.'
